text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At summer camp, Maruzensky and I work
hard to improve her running even further.
Maruzensky is in high spirits as the sun
rises on the final
day.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Come on! We
need our last day of training to
be a good
one!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Come on! We
need our last day of training to
be a good
one!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is it, you know? So let's rev up and
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An invigorated Maruzensky pushes
through the final day of training
with me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks, Trainer! Hehe, looks like
we both worked up a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks, Trainer! Hehe, looks like
we both worked up a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm exhausted, but like, exhilarated
at the same time. I feel
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
After all this training,
I can't wait for my
next race. Hehe, I think you'll
enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But hey... Are you all right? Aren't you
tired from being under the sun
for so long?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But hey... Are you all right? Aren't you
tired from being under the sun
for so long?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You sure? Don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm gonna head back and wash up.
It's important to get plenty
of rest after a
big workout!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go back to my room and take a relaxing
bath. Afterwards, I head
outside to get
some cool night air...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know what Trainer said, but we had a
really tiring day. I hope I'm not
being
selfish...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard from another student that
there's a festival going on at
the shrine
near here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll just ask!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wanna grab dinner at the food stalls
there?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's supposed to be game stalls too,
and they're doing a festival
dance! I bet
we'd have a great time together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! With that decided, I'm going to
dance my socks off at the
dance!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! This way!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! This way!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wooow! It's so crowded, isn't it? I really wanna check out this one stall, but I can't see it anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. ♪ It isn't just any old stall.
Ready
for this?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a dessert shop, and it's fresh to the
max!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All of the students are saying the
summer-only Deluxe Carrot Tower
Parfaits
are totally off the hook.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried they'll sell out
since
they're so popular, but we
should save
dessert for later.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You know what we have to do first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Da, da, dum, ba, ba, bum. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There! The dance! Aw, this takes me
back... My family used to dance
all the
time when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
let's go! It's time to get our groove
on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We join the dance, and Maruzensky
performs beautifully. Everyone
there is
feeling the excitement.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! We're not done yet! Come on,
Trainer! Feeling jiggy?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! We're not done yet! Come on,
Trainer! Feeling jiggy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the event heats up even more, the
dance grows too big to contain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! What fun! You dance pretty well,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! What fun! You dance pretty well,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was! Everyone was really jamming out! I
got so carried away I wound
up on the
main platform. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My whole body was rumbling from
standing next to the taiko drums! It
was
just the best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My mother always used to say, "When you
stand on the big stage, it's
time to boogie down." Hehe,
I guess the apple doesn't fall far from
the tree.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! We need to go get our dessert!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's go find a Deluxe Carrot Tower
Parfait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We get our carrot parfaits and enjoy the
other stalls. After seeing all
there is to see,
it's time to head back.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That parfait was fabulous! It even had ice
cream between the
macarons... My heart's
as full as my stomach. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I got to run along the ocean, join the
festival dance, and eat a rad
new dessert...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd get to spend such a
good time with someone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it was so much fun. Promise we can do it again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't need to think
about it more?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't need to think
about it more?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you say yes to everything, who knows
where my whims will take you
next?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, please, I know you're tired... But
that's right! We should plan
our next
outing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...It's really weird though.
I feel like I can
be myself with you, even
more than when
I'm alone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...It's really weird though.
I feel like I can
be myself with you, even
more than when
I'm alone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Like I can go anywhere, run however
far—anything. That's how you
make me
feel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Like I can go anywhere, run however
far—anything. That's how you
make me
feel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how you do it...
You really are
something special!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how you do it...
You really are
something special!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wow! I guess we're a good match, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of embarrassing to say this,
but... I
hope we get to keep
sharing a lot more
fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A racer and her trainer—the best of
partners! Here's to us!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A racer and her trainer—the best of
partners! Here's to us!
